scientific_integrity: Exact nonlinear positive population model; local Floquet stability follows from explicitly computed monodromy and exact calculus, supported by independently evaluated high-precision and rational calculations. The original main preprint and the key general switched-system paper were examined at full text; an additional ecological forcing preprint was abstract-only.
scientific_limitations: Local classification only; equality at a multiplier of minus one is unresolved nonlinearly. Results are specific to one-way seasonally switched interactions and do not claim general Floquet theory. Unindexed or inaccessible sources may contain additional relevant prior work.
title: A sharp one-band seasonal instability threshold in a two-species ecological feedback model
